name: agentic-github-flow-issue-chats
description: Issue chats for Claude Code and Codex: each chat takes one ready GitHub issue, prepares its branch for a pull request, then starts the chat for the next issue and archives itself once its work is on GitHub.

interface.shortDescription: Issue chats for Claude Code and Codex: each chat takes one ready GitHub issue, prepares its branch for a pull request, then starts the chat for the next issue and archives itself once its work is on GitHub.
interface.longDescription: One issue per chat: a chat picks the next ready issue by priority, checks it for overlapping work, claims it and starts its chat in a new worktree, then hands over a complete brief. The push stays on the user's yes for each branch; a chat archives itself only when its worktree is clean and its commits are on GitHub, which a Claude Code hook checks again.
